summary: The agent implements a LightGBM regression model with 5-fold cross-validation and solid feature engineering, including a complex target encoding scheme. However, it critically fails by applying in-sample target encoding to the final full training set, directly leaking the target variable into the final model's features. Additionally, it uses a random split instead of time-based or grouped splitting, ignoring the temporal and relational structure of the dataset.
